definition: [ עָצֵב , > עַצָּב ] noun [masculine] toiler (properly sufferer ; less well עֶצֶב toil Thes Kö ii. 1, 29 and others); — plural suffix עַצְּבֵיכֶם תִּנְנּ֑שֹׁוּ Isa 58:3 (dagesh forte dirimens Ges «GKC:20h»§ 20h ) your toilers ye drive on ; Klo Che עֲבֹט בְּיֶדְכֶם (compare Vrss in part) money lent on pledge ye exact.
